text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Oh no! Don't beat yourself up!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'm already so happy and grateful that you tried your best for me, so please don't feel bad!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: H-hey, why don't we get something sweet to eat? We can have sweet steamed buns or a cake or something! Anything's fine with me!
